lines: Someday we’ll skim right over us.
that plane that passed by
I remember it strangely clearly.
Though it makes no sense, somehow
On the night I wept, feeling helpless.
I simply wished to become stronger.
the courage needed for that
I was searching for it.
Even if a cruel fate were set.
And if someday it appears before me.
If just for this moment I could breathe.
I could think it doesn’t matter.
that heart.
Go far again, go far again.
Someone sings inside me.
with an unstoppable passion.
You, whose eyes were always swollen, never again
can laugh so as not to be sad.
a song to become such a hero.
Raise the peace sign, farewell.
the story that rolls onward.
to the point where I could say “I want to protect”
I knew you weren’t weak.
I was even weaker than that.
You were important to me.
“I’ll live alone,” they said.
Since that day I shouted through my mouth.
Just laugh at the me that’s changing.
the me who fears being alone
kick and bite
unable to breathe
my restless mind and deep gut
even if they become a mess
so that even pretension and scheming vanish completely.
Now I just want to touch your heart.
Someday, we surely
will even reach the distant sun.
let’s seize the pre‑dawn and smile.
Thus dyed in a blue‑flaming hue
beyond the hazy town
we should be able to run hand in hand.
steal and sketch a future with you.
a straightforward story.
Days scarred and wild
the now, worn down and frayed
revives with your words.
appears vividly.
the soul that sleeps still as a cocoon
the dream we tossed, half‑eaten, still unfinished
Take it back once more.
